_notes.start_here: This file runs Tutorial 1: HD 189733 b with ANDES YJHK and Blain24. Edit the paths for your machine. Keep a copy before changing the experiment.
_notes.where_to_read: docs/config_reference.md explains the fields and units. docs/tutorial.md shows complete examples. Tutorial 13 uses configs/hd189733b_andes_sodium_rm_clv.json for sodium with spatial RM+CLV.
_notes.planet: Open planet.parameter_file to change the orbit, stellar properties or planet size. Velocities in that file use km/s. Check the ephemeris when supplying exposure times.
_notes.instrument: Choose the instrument and its order_indices. An empty order list selects all orders. Changing the instrument also requires its own wavelength and ETC inputs.
_notes.observation: Set the exposure time, readout and event selection here. observation.throughput_seed fixes the throughput variations. noise.noise_seed fixes the additive Gaussian noise. Independent component seeds control different random draws.
_notes.atmosphere: planet_model describes the atmosphere for a homogeneous planet. With limb_asymmetries enabled, edit the four regional models. Each region has its own chemistry, temperature and velocity. ccf_template describes the spectrum used to search the prepared data.

rm_clv.simulate, correct: Both are false below. simulate includes the changing stellar spectrum during transit. correct applies an atmosphere-free stellar transit model during preparation.
rm_clv.effects: rm_clv includes stellar rotation and centre-to-limb line-profile changes. rm and clv let you inspect each effect separately.
rm_clv.coupling: factorized multiplies separately calculated stellar and planetary spectra. spatial calculates absorption of the local stellar light through the planetary atmosphere. Spatial integration includes the transit occultation.
rm_clv.model_file: Supply local stellar intensities and their continuum in an NPZ bundle. Follow docs/stellar_intensities.md. A disk-integrated stellar spectrum alone lacks the required angular information.
rm_clv.projected_obliquity_deg: Set the projected spin-orbit angle for the system when enabling RM. null leaves the angle unspecified. The stellar rotation is v_rotsini_kms in the planet file.
rm_clv.correction_method, correction_model_file: matched uses the injected opaque-body model. factorized calculates a separate stellar correction and accepts an alternative intensity bundle. Check the supported choices for the selected runner.
rm_clv.sampling: cells_across_diameter and subpixels_per_axis sample the factorized model. stellar_radial_points, planet_radial_points and azimuth_points sample the spatial model. exposure_subsamples averages over each integration. Increase sampling to check convergence.
rm_clv.normalization, wavelength_medium: continuum uses the local continuum intensities. band_mean uses the mean flux over the wavelength interval. wavelength_medium must agree with the stellar bundle and observing grid.

pipeline.seidel22.selection: The active pipeline remains Blain24. seidel22 is null below. For sodium, use the complete Tutorial 13 configuration, which selects Seidel22 and supplies its continuum windows.
pipeline.seidel22.continuum_windows_nm: List continuum intervals in stellar-frame vacuum nm. Their median sets the normalization for each exposure. Inspect the spectrum and avoid the lines being measured.
pipeline.seidel22.stellar_mask_windows_nm: List stellar-frame intervals to exclude, for example deep cores with poor S/N. An empty list adds no stellar mask.
pipeline.seidel22.minimum_continuum_pixels: Minimum number of usable continuum pixels. Preparation stops if too few remain.
pipeline.seidel22.input_telluric_corrected, input_sky_subt: For supplied observations, record the corrections already performed. The direct sodium runner fits telluric absorption before calling Seidel22.
pipeline.seidel22.noise_resamples, noise_resample_seed: For direct sodium, two or more draws repeat preparation to propagate continuum and reference uncertainty. Zero selects analytical covariance. The resample seed controls these uncertainty draws.

atomic_transmission.enabled: false keeps the Tutorial 1 molecular calculation. true selects the direct sodium simulation. Start from Tutorial 13 to set the compatible instrument, atmosphere and Seidel22 preparation together.
atomic_transmission.observing_sequence_file: NPZ with bjd exposure midpoints in BJD_TDB and a matching airmass array.
atomic_transmission.wavelength_interval_um: Observed vacuum interval retained from the selected instrument order, in micrometres.
atomic_transmission.model_wavelength_limits_um: Wider pRT interval covering the observed wavelengths, Doppler shifts and convolution margins, in micrometres.
atomic_transmission.line_wavelengths_nm: Na D2 and D1 rest wavelengths in increasing vacuum nm.
atomic_transmission.observatory_lon_lat_height: Site longitude and latitude in degrees, then height in metres.
atomic_transmission.band_half_width_kms: Half-width around each line in the planetary frame, used for band depths and light curves.
atomic_transmission.molecfit_workers: Number of simultaneous telluric fits, from 1 to 16. Choose this for your available CPU and memory.
atomic_transmission.molecfit: Fitting intervals, molecules, continuum and instrumental-width controls, and fit acceptance limits. Tutorial 13 supplies a tested set for its sodium interval.
atomic_transmission.etc_reference_exposure_seconds: Exposure time used for the ANDES ETC table. It must match the simulated exposure duration.
